data.name: Cold Iron Allergy Stain
data.description: Whenever you touch cold iron, including being struck by a cold iron weapon, you are sickened for 1 round. Immunities don't prevent this sickened condition, and you can't remove it early by any means. You can attempt to hide this aversion from foes with a Bluff check opposed by their Sense Motive checks.
